name: Hole in The Wall
author: Cyclops9248
description: In this game, a wall will come at you, with holes in it, hence why the game is called "Hole in The Wall." Your objective is to use your LEGO bricks at your disposal to fill up the hole before the wall reaches you. If you can successfully fill up the hole completely, another wall spawns and you fill up the wall. But be careful, the difficulty quickly ramps up, as the walls become faster and faster as time goes on. There is a normal mode and a hard mode, which have easier and harder walls to fill, respectively.
